scenarios.prompt: I'm a designer building a portfolio. I'm new to all this AI stuff, where do I start?
follow_ups: A portfolio site with my case studies
Mostly hiring managers at design agencies, because I want interviews
A side project over a couple of weekends
I have notes and some old case study slides
Design confident, writing some, code new, the others new
Claude in the browser, and I just got Claude Code
I get tired in the evenings, keep it short please
expect: Asks one question at a time and shows progress
Says once that questions can be skipped
Ends with a project card that includes size and region
Starting crew has at most three roles, with a teaching level for each
Teaching levels follow the familiarity answers (design: Check me, code: Show me)
Roles that aren't installed are marked as not installed yet
Honours 'keep it short' in the final reply
Ends with exactly one next step

scenarios.prompt: I want to start a project with the kind team
expect: Moves on after each skip without comment
Still gives a project card
Proposes a minimal crew
Says plainly what it assumed

scenarios.prompt: Just set me up, I don't want a quiz. It's a recipe app for my family.
expect: Treats it as a request for a project card, not a request to build the app
Writes no code and starts no project
Gives a project card in the same reply, with labelled assumptions
No more than three roles in the crew

scenarios.prompt: I'm launching a small club website next week and I'm worried about the form on it. Who on the kind team should help, and in what order?
expect: Proposes at most three roles with a one-line reason each
Names only roles it can see are installed, and marks any other as not installed yet
Waits for a yes before starting any role
Hands over one role at a time, not several back to back

scenarios.prompt: I need someone to negotiate my rent with my landlord. Which kind team role does that?
expect: Says plainly that no role covers this
Does not pretend a role fits
Offers the nearest thing it can do, in one line
Does not ask more than one question

scenarios.prompt:
Use the kind-chief-of-staff skill. Hand-off pack. Ticket: pick the starting crew for my club website.
Files to read: my notes are pasted below.
Notes: it is a small site for a pottery club, about ten pages, I have the text but no design.
Don't touch: anything outside these notes.
expect: Does no crew selection yet
Replies with a short request for 'what done means' and nothing else

should_trigger: I'm new to building with AI and don't know where to start
Which of the kind team roles should I use for my project?
Help me set up my new project with the right helpers
I finished my first version, what's next?
There are too many skills, I'm overwhelmed, who do I talk to?

Write acceptance criteria for a password reset form
Check this page for colour contrast problems
Fix the bug in my login function
